data.situation: Patient of age not recorded presents with Red triage level and chief complaint: "Doctor sahib, there is severe pain in the chest, it is going to the left arm, and I am sweating a lot. It has been for half an hour."
data.background: Symptoms reported include chest pain, sweating, arm jaw pain, and severe pain with a duration of 0.02 days. Red flags mentioned: سینے میں بہت درد ہے، بائیں بازو تک جا رہا ہے، اور بہت پسینہ آ رہا ہے۔
data.assessment: Meets triage criteria for Possible heart attack due to chest pain + sweating + arm jaw pain, age unknown, and Severe pain due to severe pain reported.
data.recommendation: Referred to Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology with needs: cath lab. Medicines already prescribed: none.
